name.es: Concejo del Pueblo de Cutler Bay

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Cutler Bay Town Council took from November 6, 2018 to October 21, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 98 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The list goes back to November 2018, when Duncan took office (Lord from December 2020, Ramirez from November 2022). Minutes from November 2018 to December 2020 (31 meetings) are posted only as PDF files behind a browser check that could not be opened, so actions start in January 2021 and Duncan's first two years are missing. The October 21, 2026 meeting has no minutes yet, and the minutes of March 19, 2025, March 22, 2023, June 21, 2023 and two items on January 18, 2023 do not record members' votes. Campaign reports are counted from 2016 for Duncan, 2018 for Lord and 2020 for Ramirez.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo del Pueblo de Cutler Bay entre el 6 de noviembre de 2018 y el 21 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 98 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La lista se remonta a noviembre de 2018, cuando Duncan asumió el cargo (Lord desde diciembre de 2020, Ramirez desde noviembre de 2022). Las actas de noviembre de 2018 a diciembre de 2020 (31 reuniones) solo están publicadas como archivos PDF detrás de una verificación del navegador que no se pudo abrir, así que los actos empiezan en enero de 2021 y faltan los dos primeros años de Duncan. La reunión del 21 de octubre de 2026 aún no tiene acta, y las actas del 19 de marzo de 2025, el 22 de marzo de 2023, el 21 de junio de 2023 y dos puntos del 18 de enero de 2023 no registran los votos de los miembros. Los informes de campaña se cuentan desde 2016 para Duncan, 2018 para Lord y 2020 para Ramirez.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vil Cutler Bay te pran ant 6 novanm 2018 ak 21 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 98 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis la kòmanse an novanm 2018, lè Duncan te pran pòs li (Lord depi desanm 2020, Ramirez depi novanm 2022). Pwosè-vèbal novanm 2018 rive desanm 2020 (31 reyinyon) pibliye sèlman an fichye PDF dèyè yon verifikasyon navigatè nou pa t ka louvri, kidonk aksyon yo kòmanse an janvye 2021 epi de premye ane Duncan yo manke. Reyinyon 21 oktòb 2026 la poko gen pwosè-vèbal, epi pwosè-vèbal 19 mas 2025, 22 mas 2023, 21 jen 2023 ak de pwen 18 janvye 2023 pa make vòt manm yo. Nou konte rapò kanpay depi 2016 pou Duncan, 2018 pou Lord ak 2020 pou Ramirez.

2021-2024 actions were read from the eSCRIBE HTML minutes (Jan 20, 2021 to Dec 4, 2024). Roger Coriat held Seat 3 until Ramirez was sworn in on Nov 28, 2022; his votes are in the Coriat column.

2021-2024 excluded under the standard: FDLE, FDEP, FDOT, Alliance for Aging, Children's Trust, Florida Communities Trust and NEAT Streets grant acceptances; interlocals with Miami-Dade County; opioid MOUs; town-only land use changes (18551 Old Cutler Road, folio 36-6003-001-0013) and comprehensive plan text amendments; land acquisition bond ordinance and intent resolutions (the bond award to TD Public Finance is listed); deferrals (Ross Stores sign variance, later withdrawn; Chabad of Homestead Sep 21, 2022; Southplace plats Sep 24, 2024), which are listed at the meeting where they were decided
Minutes record mover, seconder and "Passed" but no member-by-member vote; all five members attended. Same for 2023-01-18 items 11.a-11.b and 2023-06-21
Regular meeting held but minutes not yet posted; private-party agenda items listed with roll null
eSCRIBE minutes record mover, seconder and "Passed" for each motion but no member-by-member vote; roll and tally null (all five members attended)
Special meeting minutes record no member votes; the only action (Legacy Park master plan revision) is town-only and was deferred
Cutler Bay Community Fund grant resolutions name the dollar total but not the not-for-profit recipients; recipients are in the attached exhibits, which were not opened
Consent items carry the single consent-agenda vote, which eSCRIBE repeats under each consent item
Absent members are marked absent from the attendance block in each set of minutes
Workshops, zoning workshops and budget hearings were read; workshops take no votes

Excluded under the standard: interlocal agreements with Miami-Dade County and FDOT, state and federal grant acceptances, RFP/ITB issuances naming no vendor, code amendments, budgets and town-only brownfield designations (Blue Heron Park, town-owned property)
